commit.message: Temporary delete beeper (type1 AppImage, 2004 runtime, insecure) (sync lists) [58878218ecc95c4b383c02d52f11d5a9fc48b6fe]

Temporary delete beeper (type1 AppImage, 2004 runtime, insecure)

"am -f" do not see it as AppImage but as dynamic binary, the flag --appimage-extract seems to work on it, but the runtime is old, and also the file manager do not detects it as AppImage but as executable

The solution would be to update it to the new runtime... or if you don't care about security, to add it as "portable app"

AM is now more restrictive against these packages

fix https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM/issues/2473

commit.message:
Add opencode-desktop (#2468)

* feat: add opencode-desktop package

Adds an install script for the opencode desktop app (Electron-based
AppImage from anomalyco/opencode releases), listed alongside the
existing opencode and opencode-enhanced packages.

* fix: opencode package now installs the CLI tarball, not the desktop AppImage

Upstream anomalyco/opencode no longer ships a plain AppImage; the
opencode package's generic "mage$" filter was silently matching the
new opencode-desktop-*.AppImage asset instead. Switch it to fetch the
linux-x64 CLI tarball, matching the "the-way"-style tar.gz install
pattern, and drop it from the appimages/stats lists since it no longer
creates a desktop launcher.
